name: Activated home refuses an unavailable manager and preserves custody after marker removal
detail: Both public launcher invocations exited 1; the saved journal survived unchanged.

name: Spawn-lock probe returns the live holder without waiting or disturbing it
detail: The real lock library reported its matching holder; after release a probe acquired and released the lock.

name: Restore an overdue recovery with a living main: own once, retain its slot, and close only for matching current identity
detail: Real callbacks preserved the running attempt and occupied flock; stale start metadata did not close it; a current PID/start/boot did. No kernel KILL or harness launch is claimed.

name: An action descendant survives wrapper exit without retaining its slot descriptor
detail: The real action callback returned rc=0 and released the flock while its spawned descendant was still alive.

name: Restore an overdue technical key: publish one durable ownership receipt and close after the answer
detail: Fresh callback processes produced one ownership record with no diagnosis, then consumed the real status writer’s answer. Cadence bounds are not claimed.

name: Rapid lock observations do not escalate; a persistent live lock owns once and closes on verified acquisition
detail: Three burst observations created no incident; one appeared after 61s of real tenure without killing or stealing the holder. Recovery closed it once.
